source.title: 2026 NFL fantasy football: 7 riskiest players to draft
source.author: Bobby Kownack
source.summary: Flags premium-cost players whose workload, age, injury, role, or situation creates unusually wide downside.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: McCaffrey's 413 touches, declining rushing efficiency, and age-30 season make another first-round investment unusually fragile.
takeaways.rationale: McCaffrey's 413 touches, declining rushing efficiency, and age-30 season make another first-round investment unusually fragile.
risks: Receiving volume still preserves an elite outcome.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Love's talent is offset by a crowded backfield and little incentive for Arizona to give a rookie workhorse usage.
takeaways.rationale: Love's talent is offset by a crowded backfield and little incentive for Arizona to give a rookie workhorse usage.
risks: Preseason performance could move the role.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Rice's production is strong, but legal, suspension, knee, and role uncertainty create excessive risk at the Round 2/3 turn.
takeaways.rationale: Rice's production is strong, but legal, suspension, knee, and role uncertainty create excessive risk at the Round 2/3 turn.
risks: He can still be Kansas City's top target when active.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Dart has elite rushing upside but carries concussion, passing-development, Nabers-health, and coaching risks at QB9 cost.
takeaways.rationale: Dart has elite rushing upside but carries concussion, passing-development, Nabers-health, and coaching risks at QB9 cost.
risks: A safer rushing approach could lower his fantasy ceiling.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Kittle is appealing late but becomes an avoid if Achilles optimism pushes a 33-year-old tight end too far up boards.
takeaways.rationale: Kittle is appealing late but becomes an avoid if Achilles optimism pushes a 33-year-old tight end too far up boards.
risks: He could return for Week 1 and retain an elite connection with Brock Purdy.
takeaways.price_condition: Avoid if price rises materially above Round 9
